source: Owner direct chat after discussion of the Tripo quad export and unnecessary blanket retopology
owner_message_original: Давай проверим текущую сетку, я если что загрузил чуть более удачный вариант в папаку OwnerExports
owner_message_english_translation: Let's check the current mesh; I uploaded a somewhat better version to the OwnerExports folder.
authorized_scope: Inspect the newly supplied body mesh and test the existing topology on the exact MSQ52 rig using preserved derivatives. Perform only bounded fitting, binding and necessary local corrections needed for a valid assessment; distinguish topology defects from fit/weight errors. Compare with the prior source and identify the minimum justified repair.

executor.basis: Standing implementation baseline; the earlier max override was scoped to the completed MetaHuman experiment. Save and restore actual profile/native arguments.

preservation: The owner replaced the existing drop file. Keep its new bytes and both named source revisions; never restore old bytes over the owner file or rebaseline historical registry records. Preserve owner DefaultEditor.ini and DefaultEngine.ini edits, accepted rig, prior experiment and lobby.
boundary: No blanket retopology, new AI generation, final armor/materials, rig replacement, successor gameplay task or visual acceptance. A bounded mesh assessment does not complete full MSQ-54. No separately billed APIs, purchases or top-ups.
